issue.title: Omux-owned Codex adapter + ordinary launch/resume proof
issue.description_before:
## Current architecture and delivery

Omux owns each adapted application's authentication contract and implementation. Use sufficient native extension mechanisms or an Omux-maintained adapter delivered through plugin/configuration, upstream contribution or explicitly maintained application modification. There is no vendor-provided Omux/Codex hook prerequisite. Experimental candidate proof does not establish unmodified Codex support.

Delivery order: install/activate → Chromium source connection → verified identity and usable authority → renewal → ordinary application integration → same-process handoff. Home Manager owns fleet packages/services/exact-ID host registration; Omux owns custody/enrollment. Development and release identities and namespaces remain isolated.

## This carrier

Implement and qualify the Omux-owned Codex adapter and its explicit delivery method. Reversible setup then ordinary CLI/TUI launch and native resume; attach existing processes only through independently proved native capability. Safe request-boundary authorization substitution preserves native process/session/history/tools/approvals and accepted-work fences.

Acceptance NAC-001/003/010/018, RR-01, SC-04–06: exact candidate installed launch/resume/attachment/handoff evidence. Paths: integrations/codex-upstream/, codex-owner-candidate/, codex-owner-runtime/, codex-native-recovery-runtime/ and src/native_owner.zig. TIN-5421 owns bounded discovery; TIN-1798 custody; TIN-1818 provider seams; TIN-2057 complete product acceptance.

Current bounded evidence: retained source verification and fresh source producer passed their exact predicates; independent offline home/owner cache inventories are nonadditive. 1,596 unfetched descriptors and unresolved Git/dynamic/archive gaps do not establish complete native closure, offline analysis or compilation. Native runtime, ordinary application resume and live continuity remain unproved; native_support=false.

## Evidence and retained history

Require exact source/artifact/platform/application/provider tuple and declared locked Nix/Bazel action. Browser execution, service activation, native launch/resume, handoff and measured SLO achievement are separate gates. Builds/tests/refusals prove only stated predicates. Targets create no contractual SLA or staffed support promise. This description changes no issue state, date, assignee or dependency.
